title: lead.enriched
description: Lead Generation finished enrichment for a lead: company/contact attributes and, when grounded, a prospect profile were written with full provenance. Emitted by Lead Generation. Consumed by Qualification.

fields_enriched.description: Names of the attribute-envelope fields actually written (post confidence-threshold filtering) across company and contact, e.g. ['industry', 'employee_band', 'seniority']. Never includes a field that was dropped for low confidence.

run_id.description: agent_runs.id of the leadgen/build_prospect_profile call, the final of the three LLM calls this event follows.
